about.description: This app blocks Call of Duty server locations with Windows Firewall rules.
about.note: This app does not change game files. It only adds Windows Firewall rules.
about.title: About
admin.notice: Start CoD Server Picker as administrator.
allPrograms.explain: The rules then block these server IP ranges for all programs, not only for the game.
apply.confirmAll: You cannot find matches if you block all locations.
apply.confirmRunning: Do not apply changes during a match. Start the game again after you apply changes.
apply.title: Apply changes
error.apply: The app could not change the firewall rules. Start the app as administrator and try again.
error.audit: The app could not reset the audit policy.
error.noGame: The app did not find the game. Find the game first.
error.read: The app could not read the firewall rules.
error.record: The recording stopped because of an error.
error.title: Error
game.allPrograms: The rules apply to all programs.
notice.oldRules: Rules from an old version exist. Select Apply to remove them.
protected.title: Protected game folder
record.explain: Record the servers that the game uses. Start the recording, then play a match.
record.send: Send this file to the project to add new locations. The file contains the servers of your internet provider.
record.title: Record servers
settings.audit.explain: Use this if the app stopped during a recording.
settings.clear.explain: This deletes only the firewall rules of this app.
settings.path.none: The game path is not set.
settings.title: Settings
setup.invalidFile: This file is not cod.exe. Select the file cod.exe in the game folder.
setup.method: The app needs the path of cod.exe. Select one of these options.
setup.platform: Select the platform that you use to play.
setup.search.title: Find the game
setup.search.wait: The app looks for the game.
setup.steamFailed: The app did not find the game in Steam.
status.listUpdatedBlocks: Server list updated. Blocks are up to date.
status.pingRunning: The ping test is in progress.
status.saveFailed: The app could not save the settings.
xbox.protected: Windows protects the game folder of the Xbox app. Rules for cod.exe can fail.
xbox.untested: Xbox app support is not tested.
